raw_translation: Hii si kukamilika slicer na haina kujenga G-code, toolpaths, infill, msaada au printer mipangilio. STL files hawana kufafanua vitengo; kuthibitisha vipimo na kila safu katika slicer halisi kabla ya kuchapisha.
source: This is not a complete slicer and does not create G-code, toolpaths, infill, supports or printer settings. STL files do not define units; verify scale and every layer in a real slicer before printing.
translation: Hii si kukamilika slicer na haina kujenga G-code, toolpaths, infill, msaada au printer mipangilio. STL files hawana kufafanua vitengo; kuthibitisha vipimo na kila safu katika slicer halisi kabla ya kuchapisha.
